configuration.descriptive: D4 and E4-B-fit on the 60-min eligible population

calibration.method: causal rolling-window conformal, daily reset, nearest-in-time dev out-of-fold init, 15-min maturation

ramp_definition.anchor: ClearSkyPV fitted on all development records (349,372; all 497 dev days)
ramp_definition.tau_definition: 90th percentile of |K(t+15)-K(t)| over all 164,362 development samples
ramp_definition.event_formula: ramp iff |K(t+15) - K(t)| >= tau_test, K = PV / max(P_clear, 1 kW), K(t+15) at the matched target record, K(t) at the origin record

configuration.scoring: crps_quantile_interp; paired test-day bootstrap 10,000 resamples, stratified sunny/cloudy, seed 20261022
